description:
## Finding

The 3rd-pass api-contract supplement performed the mail-server
cross-walk that the 1st-pass and 2nd-pass confidence notes both
flagged as the highest-leverage missing exercise. Result: **7 of
the chat-server findings filed in earlier passes are workspace-
canonical (the same pattern exists in jmap-mail-server, the
canonical extension-server template)** and therefore require
workspace-wide propagation rather than chat-server-local fix.

Per the workspace AGENTS.md \"Canonical Templates\" propagation
rule and the jmap-chat-server/AGENTS.md sibling banner, fixes
for these MUST land in jmap-mail-server first, then propagate to
every extension-server sibling in the same pass.

## Re-classification table

| Finding | Mail-server analog | Citation |
|---|---|---|
| .35 (MemoryError pub String) | Identical \`pub struct MemoryError(pub String)\` | mail-server/src/memory.rs:449 |
| .38 (pub use jmap_server::ClosureHandler) | Identical re-export, plus broader bundle | mail-server/src/lib.rs:252 + backend.rs:35-38 |
| .43 (ChatBackend::limits is sync) | 4+ sync methods of same shape (max_collapse_threads_emails, max_body_value_bytes, max_delayed_send_seconds, can_calculate_mailbox_query_changes) | mail-server/src/backend.rs:243-286 |
| .46 (supports_type lacks account_id) | \`fn supports_type<O>(&self) -> bool\` — worse: lacks BOTH caller AND account_id | mail-server/src/backend.rs:234 |
| .47 (may_set_custom_emoji bool loses reason) | Same shape on 3 methods: blob_exists, supports_type, can_calculate_mailbox_query_changes | mail-server/src/backend.rs:188-193 (blob_exists), :234, :280-286 |
| .48 (register_account no doc(hidden)) | Identical \`pub fn register_account\` without doc(hidden) | mail-server/src/memory.rs:270 |
| .51 (4 more sync trait methods) | Folds into .43 above — all workspace-canonical | (same citations) |

## Special case: .49 (test-helper stability signaling)

Inverse direction: mail-server's pattern is BETTER than chat-
server's. Mail-server has explicit two-place stability banners:

- mail-server/src/memory.rs:20-24 — module-level \"API stability
  is opt-in: it may break across minor versions while the crate
  is pre-1.0\"
- mail-server/src/lib.rs:31-40 — feature paragraph carries the
  same wording

Chat-server has a single-place banner (memory.rs only). This is
chat-server **drift from canonical** — fix is chat-server-local
to mirror the canonical pattern, not a propagation epic.

## Special case: .39 (apply_space_metadata_patch leaks
serde_json::Map)

Inverse direction: mail-server uses the typed \`O::Patch\`
associated type via the \`SetObject\` trait. Mail-server's
\`update_object\` at backend.rs:120-126 uses \`O::Patch\` rather
than a raw JSON map. Chat-server's
\`apply_space_metadata_patch\` bypasses this with a
\`serde_json::Map<String, Value>\` arg, drifting from the
established canonical pattern.

The fix for chat-server is to migrate to the typed-patch
pattern, mirroring mail-server. Not a propagation epic — chat-
server-local.

## Findings confirmed chat-server-LOCAL (no mail-server analog)

For the record, these chat-server findings are NOT workspace-
canonical:

- .33 (SlowModeError missing non_exhaustive) — no mail-server
  analog type
- .34 (OpResult missing non_exhaustive) — no mail-server analog
- .36 (generate_invite_code contract) — chat-only feature
- .37 (required_permissions_for_op sentinel) — no mail analog
  (mail has reverse-direction sentinel pattern on \`create_object\`
  inputs — see new finding below)
- .40 (expire_message doc-vs-type) — chat-only
- .41 (is_contact_blocked direction) — chat-only
- .50 (SlowModeError missing Error+Display) — no analog type

## New patterns discovered in mail-server during the cross-walk

These are not chat-server findings but are noted here for the
workspace-wide audit trail. None of them appear in chat-server's
surface (verified). They are mail-server-LOCAL gaps a future
mail-server review pass should examine:

- N1: mail-server \`create_object\` accepts sentinel placeholder
  string inputs (\"placeholder\", \"placeholder-blob\", 0) the
  backend must replace (mail-server backend.rs:64-87)
- N2: \`find_thread_by_message_ids\` MUST-override contract
  expressed in prose only, footgun ID generator (mail-server
  backend.rs:159-172)
- N3: \`batch_destroy_emails\` quietly serial default impl
  (mail-server backend.rs:288-318)
- N4: \`blob_exists -> bool\` loses transient-error case
  (mail-server backend.rs:188-193)
- N5: \`register_*_handlers\` macro duplicated across 3 entry
  points (mail-server lib.rs:144-157, 282-295, 325-338)
- N6: \`register_mdn_handlers\` config knob is positional —
  SemVer-breaking to add a second knob (mail-server lib.rs:275-278)

## Implication for fix planning

Seven existing chat-server findings (.35, .38, .43, .46, .47,
.48, .51) should each get a workspace-canonical parent epic
created, with jmap-mail-server treated as the canonical landing
site. Per the propagation rule, fixing these in chat-server
alone is a regression of the cookie-cutter intent.

The remaining workspace-local findings (.49 banner drift, .39
typed-patch migration) are chat-server-local and can land
independently.

## Engineering basis

Direct cross-walk of:
- crate-jmap-mail-server/src/backend.rs (319 lines)
- crate-jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs (352 lines)
- crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs public-surface subset

Each citation above is a verified file:line in the named crate.
title: Workspace-canonical re-classification: 7 prior api-contract findings (.35/.38/.43/.46/.47/.48/.51) also present in mail-server
